app.post('/admin/users', { preHandler: guards.adminSecured }, async (request, reply) => { const p = createSchema.safeParse(request.body); if (!p.success) return reply.code(400).send(error('Invalid user payload', 'VALIDATION_ERROR')); if (await repository.findUserByEmail(p.data.email)) return reply.code(409).send(error('Email already exists', 'CONFLICT')); const { temporaryPassword, ...v } = p.data, passwordHash = await crypto.hashPassword(temporaryPassword); const item = await repository.transaction(async (tx) => { const created = await tx.createUser({ ...v, passwordHash, mustChangePassword: true }); await tx.addAudit({ actorUserId: request.auth!.user.id, action: 'user.created', entityType: 'user', entityId: created.id, ...requestInfo(request) }); return created; }); return reply.code(201).send({ data: item }); });

app.patch<{ Params: { id: string } }>('/admin/users/:id', { preHandler: guards.adminSecured }, async (request, reply) => { const id = uuid.safeParse(request.params.id), p = updateSchema.safeParse(request.body); if (!id.success || !p.success) return reply.code(400).send(error('Invalid user update', 'VALIDATION_ERROR')); const current = await repository.findUserById(id.data); if (!current) return reply.code(404).send(error('User not found', 'NOT_FOUND')); const demotesAdmin = current.role === 'admin' && current.isActive && (p.data.role === 'owner' || p.data.isActive === false); if (demotesAdmin && await repository.countActiveAdmins() <= 1) return reply.code(409).send(error('The last active admin cannot be removed', 'LAST_ADMIN')); const item = await repository.transaction(async (tx) => { const updated = await tx.updateUser(id.data, p.data); if (demotesAdmin) await tx.revokeUserSessions(id.data, now()); await tx.addAudit({ actorUserId: request.auth!.user.id, action: 'user.updated', entityType: 'user', entityId: id.data, metadata: { fields: Object.keys(p.data) }, ...requestInfo(request) }); return updated; }); return { data: item }; });

app.post<{ Params: { id: string } }>('/admin/users/:id/reset-password', { preHandler: guards.adminSecured }, async (request, reply) => { const id = uuid.safeParse(request.params.id), p = z.strictObject({ temporaryPassword: password }).safeParse(request.body); if (!id.success || !p.success) return reply.code(400).send(error('Invalid password reset', 'VALIDATION_ERROR')); if (!(await repository.findUserById(id.data))) return reply.code(404).send(error('User not found', 'NOT_FOUND')); const at = now(), hash = await crypto.hashPassword(p.data.temporaryPassword); await repository.transaction(async (tx) => { await tx.updateUser(id.data, { passwordHash: hash, mustChangePassword: true }); await tx.revokeUserSessions(id.data, at); await tx.addAudit({ actorUserId: request.auth!.user.id, action: 'user.password_reset', entityType: 'user', entityId: id.data, ...requestInfo(request) }); }); return { data: { passwordReset: true } }; });
